messageFirstRow.title: A quiet little reminder
messageFirstRow.content: You make everyone feel welcome. Please never stop being that person.

messageFirstRow.title: One thing I appreciate
messageFirstRow.content: You always remember the small details. It means more than you know.

messageFirstRow.title: A tiny confession
messageFirstRow.content: I still laugh about that playlist you made for the road trip.

messageSecondRow.title: Just wanted to say
messageSecondRow.content: Your encouragement helped me take a chance I was nervous about.

messageSecondRow.title: A note for your day
messageSecondRow.content: You deserve the same kindness you hand out to everyone else.

messageSecondRow.title: A little truth
messageSecondRow.content: I think you’re braver than you give yourself credit for.
